title: Telangana Construction Workers Welfare Board Ko Tax Exemption Mili for AYs 2024-25 to 2026-27!
content:
# Telangana Construction Workers Welfare Board Ko Tax Exemption Mili for AYs 2024-25 to 2026-27!

Ek important update hai! Government ne Telangana Construction Workers Welfare Board ke liye Income Tax Act, 1961 ke Section 10(46) ke तहत tax exemption announce kiya hai. Yeh exemption Assessment Years (AYs) 2024-25 se 2026-27 tak applicable hoga.

**Kya hai is update mein?**

*   **Exempted Body:** Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
*   **Applicable Assessment Years:** AY 2024-25, AY 2025-26, aur AY 2026-27. Yeh exemption retrospective effect se lagu hoga, yaani Financial Years 2023-24 se 2025-26 ke liye.
*   **Specified Income Covered:**
    *   Cess received.
    *   Registration aur renewal fees jo building aur other construction workers se collect ki jaati hain.
    *   Bank deposits par mila interest.
*   **Conditions for Exemption:** Is exemption ka benefit lene ke liye, Board ko kuch shartein poori karni hongi:
    *   Koi commercial activity mein engage nahi hona chahiye.
    *   Activities aur specified income ka nature relevant financial years mein unchanged rehna chahiye.
    *   Income Tax Act, 1961 ke Section 139(4C)(g) ke anusaar income tax return file karna hoga.
*   **Notification Details:** Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne yeh exemption Notification No. 149/2026 dated November 20, 2026, S.O. 6323(E) ke through notify kiya hai.

Yeh कदम construction workers ke welfare activities ko support karne aur Board ki financial burden ko kam karne mein madad karega.
